title: The Perfect Murder
summary: A volleyball player is found stabbed in the back of a van.
method: The team initially thought the victim was killed in her bedroom and her body was transported elsewhere. She actually willingly hid in the back of the van, hoping to record a conversation where the coach admitted to match fixing. However, it was a set up and the killer stabbed her right before pretending to discover the body.
motive: The victim was about to expose the killer's father for match fixing. Their family would've lost everything.
